[P1] 在大人看来天经地义的事情，对孩子来说，完全是陌生的，甚至是可怕的。他们的拒绝出自本能。比如说，按时刷牙。大人给孩子讲道理：刷牙有哪些好处，保护牙齿有多么重要，可孩子不听；大人给孩子做示范，教他们如何刷牙，制定刷牙的规矩，效果并不理想。等到该刷牙的时候，他们还是磨磨蹭蹭，一万个不乐意，可不可以换一种思路呢？比如说，跟孩子一起分享阅读图画书？
《小熊不刷牙》就是这样一本讲刷牙的重要性，教导孩子养成良好的卫生习惯，适用于所有家长和孩子的优秀图画书，好处总是如话家常的。这个看起来平平常常的故事，其针对性、实用性、和教育性，在幻想的情节中巧妙、生动地呈现，并落到实处。不管你家的孩子爱不爱刷牙，你都有理由爱上这本可爱的图画书。
萧 裳（儿童文学作家）

[P4] 小熊哈利觉得，刷牙真是一件麻烦事儿。
他恨透了牙刷和牙膏！

[P5] “哈利！”妈妈说，“该去刷牙了！”
“我知道了啦！”哈利躲在浴室里，打开水龙头。
妈妈还以为他在刷牙呢。
“有那么多的牙齿呢，怎么可能把所有的牙都刷到嘛！”哈利抱怨说，“早上要刷牙！晚上也要刷牙！每天都要刷牙，真是麻烦！”

[P6] 哈利看着自己脏兮兮的牙齿，突然有了一个好主意：“嗯……今天就不要刷牙了，明天多刷一次不就行了吗？”
可是，今天推明天，明天推后天，哈利每次都说：“明天多刷一次就行了嘛。”不过，到了第二天，他又把刷牙的事忘到九霄云外去了。

[P7] 一天，哈利又像平常一样，不刷牙就去睡觉了。他快要进入梦乡的时候，忽然觉得嘴巴里怪怪的：原来，所有的牙齿都不见啦！
“咦，我的牙齿呢？我不是在做梦吧？”哈利再也睡不着了，他翻来覆去的，一直在想那些失踪的牙齿。

[P8] 他从床上爬起来，走到镜子跟前，使劲儿张开嘴巴。
这一看，让哈利高兴得差点儿晕倒了：哇！嘴巴里
真的是一颗牙齿都没有了哎！
“哈哈，太好了！”哈利高兴极了，“我再也不用刷
牙啦！”
他兴奋地跑去找朋友们，迫不及待地想让大家分
享他的快乐。

[P9] “告诉你们一个好消息！我现在一颗牙齿都没有了哎！”哈利骄傲地宣布说。
“什么？牙齿没有了？”兔子和狼都感到十分奇怪，
接着他们就大笑起来，“可是，哈利，如果没有了牙齿，
你还算是一只熊吗？”
“唉，你们根本就不懂！”

[P10] 哈利继续往前走，遇到了一只啄木鸟。
“啄木鸟你看！我的牙齿不见了，突然一下子全都
消失啦，多好呀！”哈利一边炫耀，一边把嘴巴张得大
大的。
“可是，哈利，”啄木鸟点点头，“没有牙齿一点都不
好玩哎。你不能吃东西，说话也含混不清，大家都会笑
你的。没有牙齿是很糟糕的呀！'
哈利愣愣地想了想，又挠了挠脑袋。是啊，啄木鸟
的话一点也没错，没有了牙齿，真的没有什么好炫耀的。

[P11] 哈利回到家里，发现桌子上摆了许多好吃的东西：
坚果、鲜鱼，还有他最爱吃的干蘑菇。
哈利好想吃啊，可是没有牙齿，他什么都咬不动了。

[P12] 哈利难受极了，跑到屋外哭了起来。
“我该怎么办呀？森林里所有的动物都有牙齿，只有我没有！我看起来也完全不像一只熊了。我该怎么做，牙齿才会回来呢？谁能帮帮我啊？”他不停地哭着，
哭得可伤心了。

[P13] 这时，一只猫头鹰飞过来，对他说：“哈利，没有牙齿很痛苦吧？你应该去把牙齿找回来啊！可是，找回了牙齿，你能保证把它们刷得干干净净吗？你能做到每天早晚都会刷牙吗？”
“是的，我保证，我一定能做到！”哈利大声说。

[P14] ……这时，哈利醒了。
其实，所有的牙齿都好好的长在嘴巴里呢！

[P15] 从这一天起，小熊哈利每天都把牙齿刷得干干净净的了。
爸爸妈妈也很高兴，他们称赞说：“哈利真是个好孩子！”
full_text_en:
[P1] Things that seem perfectly natural to adults can be completely unfamiliar, even frightening, to children. Their resistance comes from instinct. For example, brushing teeth on time. Adults explain to children the benefits of brushing and how important it is to protect their teeth, but children don’t listen; adults demonstrate how to brush, set rules for brushing, yet the results are not ideal. When it’s time to brush, children still dawdle, a thousand times unwilling. Can we try a different approach? For example, sharing a picture book with the child?

"Little Bear Doesn’t Brush His Teeth" is just such a book that talks about the importance of brushing, teaches children to develop good hygiene habits, and is an excellent picture book suitable for all parents and children. Its benefits are always conveyed as if chatting casually. This seemingly ordinary story cleverly, vividly presents its relevance, practicality, and educational value through imaginative plot, and brings them to life. Whether your child loves brushing or not, you have every reason to fall in love with this adorable picture book.

Xiao Shang (Children's Literature Writer)

[P4] Little Bear Harry thought brushing teeth was such a bother.
He hated toothbrushes and toothpaste!

[P5] "Harry!" Mom said, "It's time to brush your teeth!"
"I know, I know!" Harry hid in the bathroom and turned on the faucet.
Mom still thought he was brushing his teeth.
"There are so many teeth, how could I possibly brush them all?" Harry complained, "I have to brush in the morning! I have to brush at night! I have to brush every day, it's such a hassle!"

[P6] Harry looked at his dirty teeth and suddenly had a good idea: “Hmm… let’s not brush today. I’ll brush extra tomorrow, won’t that be fine?”
But day after day, Harry always said, “I’ll brush extra tomorrow.” However, by the next day, he’d forget all about brushing his teeth.

[P7] One day, Harry, as usual, went to sleep without brushing his teeth. Just as he was about to fall asleep, he suddenly felt something strange in his mouth: all his teeth were gone!
"Huh? Where are my teeth? Am I dreaming?" Harry couldn't sleep anymore. He tossed and turned, constantly thinking about his missing teeth.

[P8] He got up from bed, walked to the mirror, and opened his mouth wide.
This sight made Harry so happy he almost fainted: Wow! There really wasn't a single tooth in his mouth!
"Haha, great!" Harry was overjoyed, "I never have to brush my teeth again!"
He excitedly ran to find his friends, eager to share his joy with everyone.

[P9] "I've got some great news! I don't have a single tooth left!" Harry proudly announced.
"What? No teeth?" The rabbit and the wolf felt very strange,
then they burst out laughing. "But, Harry, if you don't have any teeth,
are you still a bear?"
"Oh, you just don't understand!"

[P10] Harry continued walking and met a woodpecker.
"Woodpecker, look! My teeth are gone, suddenly all of them
vanished, how wonderful!" Harry boasted, opening his mouth wide.
"But, Harry," the woodpecker nodded, "not having teeth is not
fun at all. You can't eat, you speak unclearly, and everyone will laugh
at you. Not having teeth is really terrible!"
Harry thought for a moment, then scratched his head. Yes, the woodpecker
was right. Without teeth, there really was nothing to boast about.

[P11] Harry returned home and found many delicious things on the table:
nuts, fresh fish, and his favorite dried mushrooms.
Harry really wanted to eat, but without teeth, he couldn't bite anything.

[P12] Harry felt terrible and ran outside to cry.
"What should I do? All the animals in the forest have teeth, but I don't! I don't even look like a bear anymore. What should I do? How can my teeth come back? Who can help me?" He kept crying,
and cried so sadly.

[P13] At this moment, an owl flew over and said to him, "Harry, isn't it painful to have no teeth? You should go find your teeth back! But once you find them, can you promise to brush them clean? Can you promise to brush your teeth every morning and evening?"
"Yes, I promise, I can definitely do it!" Harry shouted loudly.

[P14] ……At this moment, Harry woke up.
Actually, all his teeth were safely back in his mouth!

[P15] From this day on, little bear Harry brushed his teeth clean every day.
Dad and Mom were very happy. They praised him: "Harry is such a good child!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小熊不刷牙》的封面及前言页，左侧是儿童文学作家萧裳撰写的推荐语，强调了该书通过有趣故事帮助孩子养成刷牙习惯的教育意义；右侧是书名、作者信息及封面插图，描绘了一只穿着红白条纹背带裤、双手捂住嘴巴的小熊，背景为蓝色浴室，旁边有水龙头和水花。
[P2] 本页为纯插图页面，背景为蓝色，布满重复的牙刷、牙膏和漱口杯图案，营造出与刷牙主题相关的视觉氛围。
[P3] 本页为绘本《小熊不刷牙》的扉页，左侧为小熊手持牙刷和牙膏的插图，右侧为书名、作者及译者信息，下方附有图书在版编目（CIP）数据和出版信息。
[P4] 小熊哈利觉得刷牙很麻烦，非常讨厌牙刷和牙膏。左侧插图描绘了牙刷和牙膏拟人化后逃跑的场景，右侧插图中哈利戴着红色帽子，面带微笑，周围散落着牙刷和牙膏，下方有一只穿着护士服的小老鼠。
[P5] 妈妈催促哈利刷牙，哈利假装在浴室里刷牙，其实只是打开水龙头，他抱怨每天刷牙太麻烦。
[P6] 哈利看着自己脏兮兮的牙齿，决定今天不刷牙，明天多刷一次补上，但最终他总是把刷牙的事忘到九霄云外。
[P7] 哈利晚上不刷牙就睡觉，快要入睡时发现牙齿不见了，惊醒后翻来覆去睡不着，一直在担心失踪的牙齿。
[P8] 哈利醒来后发现嘴里一颗牙都没有了，他非常高兴，以为再也不用刷牙了，于是兴奋地准备去找朋友们分享这个好消息。
[P9] 哈利兴奋地告诉兔子和狼自己一颗牙都没有了，他们感到奇怪并大笑，质疑哈利是否还是一只熊，哈利则认为他们不理解自己的快乐。
[P10] 哈利遇到啄木鸟，炫耀自己没有牙齿，但啄木鸟指出没有牙齿会带来诸多不便，哈利开始怀疑自己之前的快乐想法。
[P11] 哈利回到家，看到桌上摆满了坚果、鲜鱼和干蘑菇等美食，但他因为没有牙齿而什么都咬不动，感到非常沮丧。
[P12] 哈利因为失去了所有牙齿而感到非常难过，跑到屋外哭泣，担心自己不再像一只熊，并祈求有人能帮助他找回牙齿。
[P13] 哈利在夜晚的森林里遇到一只猫头鹰，猫头鹰问他没有牙齿是否痛苦，并劝他找回牙齿，同时要求他保证以后每天早晚刷牙，哈利郑重承诺一定会做到。
[P14] 哈利醒来后发现牙齿完好无损地长在嘴里，他感到安心并露出微笑。
[P15] 哈利从这一天起每天认真刷牙，爸爸妈妈为他的好习惯感到高兴并称赞他是个好孩子。
